# setup-engine

Arguments: `[engine] | [engine version] | refresh | upgrade [old-version] [new-version] | no args for guided selection` (take them from the user's message).

This is the Codex entry point for the upstream skill
`.claude/skills/setup-engine/SKILL.md`, which stays the single source of truth.

1. Read `.claude/skills/setup-engine/SKILL.md` in full before doing anything else.
2. If it has lines starting with `` !` ``, they are startup commands. Run each
   one from the repository root with `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}` = `.claude/skills/setup-engine`
   and treat the output as the config block the skill says is "resolved above".
   At the time of porting these were:

   ```bash
   bash ".claude/hooks/yaml-helper.sh" resolve_config --keys workflow
   ```

3. Follow the skill exactly, translating Claude Code vocabulary with the
   "Codex compatibility" table in `AGENTS.md`. In particular, every
   `AskUserQuestion` means: ask in chat with numbered options, then stop and
   wait for the user's reply.
